assumptions: Original robot design without an image reference; all visible and hidden surfaces, proportions and mechanics are authored.
The biped has real independently weighted torso, upper arms, forearms, thighs and shins, with rigid toy-like joints rather than deforming soft skin.
Anatomical left is world +X and right is world -X for the -Y-facing rest pose.
Head, hands, feet and held-tool descendants are unbound rest transforms under the ten controlled body bones; no finger, visor or antenna actuation is inferred.
The workpiece and assembly probe are rigid held props. Probe strokes and inspection are gestures; no circuit simulation, generated marks or manufacturing occurs.
Weft retargeting uses the existing simulated body frames; authored clips are provenance and not alternate simulation actions.
Materials are explicitly opaque matte diffuse with metallic=0 and roughness=1. Gold is a paint color, not a metallic shader.
Keyframe rotations/translations use model rest axes and are converted through bone rest bases by the builder.
Neutral frame matrices and Z-up/-Y-front orientation are a user-authorized authoring proposal, NOT observed Weft state or metric calibration.
Visual alignment with Weft remains unverified. Recompute offsets using its actual neutral frame matrices before claiming aligned integration.
Weft has 19 joint angles plus root translation. Unmapped head, hands, fingers and accessories do not acquire independent simulated anatomy.
Authored clips are provenance; they must not override simulated pose.
prompt_history: Create a genuinely new complete humanoid robot, not a lamp or an animal reskin. Give it a rounded blue torso, cream front panel, friendly dark visor with two warm eyes, small antenna, two articulated arms and legs with real elbow/knee pivots, solid toy hands and broad feet. Anatomical left is world +X and right is world -X for a front facing -Y. Use only opaque matte diffuse materials with metallic=0 and roughness=1 exactly. The left hand carries a small circuit workpiece and the right holds an assembly probe. Idle gently rocks; making_something uses short probe strokes at the low-held workpiece; working raises the workpiece for inspection; milestone_level_up raises both tools with one joyful hop. Key only the ten body-frame bones; head/hands/feet/tool descendants keep authored local rest transforms. Supply editable scene data, real skin weights and complete hidden surfaces for weft-v1; do not change or simulate Weft physics, actions or rewards.
